title: Later Mughals Rafi Ud Daula
definition: Rafi-ud-Daula, also known by his regnal title Shah Jahan II, was a puppet Mughal Emperor who reigned briefly in 1719 under the control of the Sayyid Brothers.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Era of Kingmakers' (1713–1720) and the rapid decline of central Mughal authority post-Aurangzeb.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Later Mughals Rafi Ud Daula.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
